paragraphs.text: Hyena is a creature type first used for Gibbering Hyenas in Mirage , but in pluralized form. The first actual printing of this type was in Unhinged .
Hyenas were made Hounds in the Grand Creature Type Update , but that was reverted in the Update following the Grand Update, probably for taxonomic reasons.

More recently, Trusty Companion has been featured in Kaladesh , indicating that this is now a proper creature type. Hyenas are therefore now represented in both green and white . Amonkhet would later introduce hyenas in red via Hyena Pack .
The first hyena-folk was introduced on Cackling Prowler ( Foundations ). Their culture and plane of origin remain unknown.
